description: Retrieves a single file from a GitLab repository at a specific ref (branch, tag, or commit). Returns the file content as base64-encoded data along with metadata like size, encoding, and commit information. Use this action when you need to fetch the contents or details of a specific file from a GitLab project repository.

file_path.description: URL-encoded full path to the file in the repository.
file_path.title: File Path

project_id.description: The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.
project_id.title: Project Id

ref.description: Name of branch, tag, or commit. Use 'HEAD' to automatically use the default branch.
ref.title: Ref

name: get_file

blob_id.description: The Git blob ID of the file.
blob_id.title: Blob Id

commit_id.description: The commit ID of the last commit that modified this file.
commit_id.title: Commit Id

content_sha256.description: SHA256 hash of the file content.
content_sha256.title: Content Sha256

execute_filemode.description: Whether the file has execute permissions.
execute_filemode.title: Execute Filemode

file_path.description: The full path to the file in the repository.
file_path.title: File Path

last_commit_id.description: The last commit ID (same as commit_id).
last_commit_id.title: Last Commit Id

ref.description: The branch, tag, or commit ref used to retrieve the file.
ref.title: Ref

size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
size.title: Size
